pr_title: sql,copy: fix test infrastructure and update pgconn
pr_body:
sql/copy: update jackc/pgconn to fix copy bug

Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/88801

Release note: None

sql,copy: fix test infrastructure

Previously we hacked around lack of copy protocol support in logictest
by doing an in memory hack that bypassed the client connection entirely.
Now that the client supports use pgx to support copy use that instead.

Also move copy test stuff to its own package.

Fixes: #84619

Release note: None

issue_context.title: copy: client side of copy in pgconn has an I/O race
issue_context.body:
https://github.com/jackc/pgconn/issues/128

Not sure if this is a regression or a release blocker but figured a tracking issue was worthwhile.  I think this doesn't affect 22.1 because we used lib/pq?   So this should probably be a release blocking regression.

The bug is a race that only occurs when failing (ie malformed in some way) COPY commands are occurring so its a bit of an edge case.

Jira issue: CRDB-19973
comments:
Hi @cucaroach, please add branch-* labels to identify which branch(es) this release-blocker affects.

<sub>:owl: Hoot! I am a [Blathers](https://github.com/apps/blathers-crl), a bot for [CockroachDB](https://github.com/cockroachdb). My owner is [otan](https://github.com/otan).</sub>
I would say this isn't a release blocker as it's a problem only if there's an error. Also in actuality I think commands would not be run so close together that it'd race.
I'll remove the release-blocker label since the bug is hard to encounter, but let's still fix and backport
